issues.problem: The coffee maker faces the wall behind the sideboard, putting its controls and dispensing side away from the accessible side.
issues.fix: Rotate the coffee maker 180 degrees so its front faces into the room.

issues.problem: The drinking mug sits directly on the floor beside a plant, away from any usable drinking or work surface.
issues.fix: Place the mug on a small side table near the plant, preserving the required maximum distance of 0.5 m between the mug and obj_0077.
